svg.font-family: "Inter Variable", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
svg.title: A tool call through the MCP portal
svg.desc: An MCP client calls a tool at the project's portal. Kaeso checks the caller's sign-in, tool access and tool call rate, signs in to the MCP server with the shared or the caller's own connection, calls the tool and logs the call.
